_comment: SPARK — S167: the SIX TIER-9 TOWER DESTRUCTION CINEMATICS — the owner's crumble.
⭐ OWNER, RACE_ZONES_AND_BOSS_TOWERS.md §B: *"the tower would spawn 1 boss and then the tower
would crumble with a cool video generated"*, and — the load-bearing half — *"the effect should
not be a cutscene like voltkin but in-game tower that spawns-releases the boss, and then
crymbnles down in a cool video cinematic"*. Not a cutscene means the sim never stops.
⭐ SEEDED OFF THE **DAMAGED** STILL, NOT THE INTACT ONE — the tier-3 destroy spec's own choice.
The collapse should begin from a building that is already visibly failing, so the cinematic reads
as the END of the damage the player watched rather than as a separate event.
⛔ THE DEMON ENTRY INVERTS, AND IT IS AN OWNER RULING: *"for hellmouth is the opposite - it
closes as it gets destroyed."* A hellmouth is a WIDE LOW GROUND FEATURE, not a tower, so a
collapse-inward would be meaningless for it. It grinds shut instead.
⚠ THE GRAVITY CLAUSE IS CARRIED VERBATIM from the tower design spec, where it exists because
REV 1 produced rubble floating at mid-fall angles. It is repeated in every prompt rather than

destroy.prompt: The royal vampire's coffin standing upright on its stepped bier from the reference image. The coffin's lid splits and the whole bier COLLAPSES INWARD, timbers folding down into a low heap of splintered wood and iron while a burst of bats scatters out and flees away low. The structure is shown on a seamless blank sheet of pure WHITE paper filling the entire frame. The collapse is COMPLETE by two thirds of the way through: for the rest of the clip the settled wreckage lies COMPLETELY STILL on the ground, not moving at all. ⛔ GRAVITY: every broken or detached piece must come to REST ON THE GROUND at the base — lying flat, leaning, or half-buried in its own rubble. Nothing floats, hangs, dangles or stops at a mid-fall angle. The camera does not move.
